Control Description: Backup jobs are monitored and failures are investigated and resolved
Test Objective: Determine whether financial system backup jobs are monitored and failures addressed
Audit Procedure: Inspect backup job logs and trace failed jobs to investigation and resolution records
Evidence Reviewed: Backup logs; monitoring alerts; incident tickets
Auditor Conclusion: All sampled backup executions completed successfully or had documented investigation and resolution.

Control Description: Critical financial processing jobs are monitored and failed executions investigated
Test Objective: Determine whether scheduled financial processing jobs are monitored and failures addressed
Audit Procedure: Inspect scheduled job execution logs and verify that failed executions were investigated and resolved
Population: 250 scheduled financial processing job executions during 2025
Evidence Reviewed: Job execution logs; exception records; incident tickets
Exception Identified: Two sampled failed job executions lacked documented investigation and resolution evidence.
Auditor Conclusion: The control did not operate effectively for the samples tested. Further investigation is required to determine whether financial reporting was affected.

Control Description: Incidents affecting financial systems are logged prioritized assigned and tracked through resolution
Test Objective: Determine whether financial system incidents are appropriately managed
Audit Procedure: Select incidents affecting financial systems and inspect classification investigation assignment and closure records
Evidence Reviewed: Incident tickets; investigation notes; priority records; closure records
Auditor Conclusion: All sampled incidents had documented classification investigation and closure evidence.

Control Description: Recovery arrangements are documented and tested periodically
Test Objective: Determine whether critical financial systems have tested recovery arrangements
Audit Procedure: Inspect annual recovery test results and verify that identified issues were tracked to resolution
Evidence Reviewed: Recovery plans; test results; remediation records
Exception Identified: One recovery test identified a recovery-time objective failure that remained unresolved at year-end.
Auditor Conclusion: The control did not operate effectively for the sample tested. The unresolved recovery issue requires further evaluation and remediation.
